note: Recorded instrument samples used by tools/render_real.mjs (tools/music-real/) for the music extracts in audition/real/. Fetch them with node tools/fetch_music_samples.mjs (into tools/music-samples/files/, git-ignored). Each file URL is base + path; licenceUrl is the licence file in the same repository at the same commit. Not sampled (made in the renderer): the low sine thump layered under the kick, the Italo track's synth bass, arpeggio and lead, and the reverb impulses (decaying noise).

sources.author: Versilian Studios and Karoryfer Samples (drummer Austin McMahon, recorded at Virtuosity Musical Instruments, Boston)
sources.what: acoustic drum kit (kick, snare, hi-hats, cymbals; kick, snare, overhead, mid and room mics) and hand percussion (congas, bongos, shaker, tambourine, cowbell)

sources.author: Karoryfer Samples (Black And Blue Basses, "darkblack" bass guitar)
sources.what: electric bass guitar, fingered: sustained notes, staccato notes and ghost notes, 4 dynamics

sources.author: Karoryfer Samples, recorded by Brian Wood (black Hofner Club electric guitar)
sources.what: electric guitar (Hofner Club hollow body) single notes: open notes (2 dynamics), staccato (muted) notes, release noises (the strings damped: used for the dead strums)

sources.author: Versilian Studios (Sam Gossner), VSCO 2 Community Edition
sources.what: orchestral strings (violin section spiccato and sustained; viola and cello sections sustained, with vibrato) and brass (trumpet and tenor trombone staccato)

sources.author: Karoryfer Samples (Weresax)
sources.what: alto saxophone sustained notes (condenser mic), loud and soft

sources.author: Versilian Studios and Karoryfer Samples (Osiris Piano)
